name: CoFailMed
description: Aligned per-case Dice scores for auditing shared failures in medical-segmentation model pools: 11 frozen pretrained encoders x 4 readout seeds x 5 tasks, with added checkpoints, held-out tasks, readout and adaptation controls, nnU-Net, mask-alignment, per-rater, content-group Kvasir, medical-encoder and AMOS22 extensions, pairwise error-mask overlaps, plus analysis reference outputs. No images, masks, predictions, features or weights are included.

affiliation.name: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology

citeAs: @inproceedings{choi2026cofailmed, title = {{Different Models, Shared Failures: Auditing Frozen-Encoder Pools for Medical Segmentation}}, author = {Choi, Eunseob and Kim, Kyeonghun and Lee, Hyuk-Jae and Kim, Nam-Joon}, booktitle = {Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems}, year = {2026}, note = {NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track}, url = {https://openreview.net/forum?id=sgt45cOBtI}}
rai:dataCollection: Derived from public medical-imaging datasets (Kvasir-SEG, ACDC, BraTS 2024 GLI, RIGA+, ISIC-2018, Medical Segmentation Decathlon, AMOS22): each released value is the Dice score of one trained model on one test case, computed by the study code.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Primary heads: frozen FP32 features, 224x224 inputs, 1x1 readouts, seeds 42-45, 30 epochs, batch 16; per-case Dice without smoothing. Scores are stored as float64 without rounding, filtering or reordering.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: No new annotations. Ground truth comes from the upstream datasets; RIGA uses the 4-of-6 rater consensus and, for the per-rater panels, each rater mask.
rai:dataUseCases: Recomputing the paper's case-level dependence statistics and reusing the protocol for evaluation research. Not for clinical decision-making, individual profiling or re-identification.
rai:dataLimitations: Scores describe fixed public cohorts and the evaluated model pools; they are not validated for clinical deployment. Phikon-derived values and all images, masks, predictions, features and weights are excluded.
rai:dataBiases: Inherits the sampling, site, scanner and annotation characteristics of the upstream datasets; no demographic or fairness analysis is performed.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Contains upstream case identifiers needed for alignment and resampling, and no demographic or clinical attributes. Some upstream file names carry source-group labels; identifiers do not guarantee anonymity.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Makes dependence assumptions in medical-segmentation model pools auditable; a pool should not be considered clinically safe on this evidence alone.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Files are fixed to the paper version and verified by MANIFEST.sha256; errors are reported through GitHub issues.
